## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]] 17 dishes (4 Venezuela-only, e.g. pabellón criollo, cachapa); [[FmLAMA]] 10 dishes (e.g. asado negro, golfeado, naiboa); [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] 48 recipes tagged `venezuelan`; [[RecipeDB2]] ≈80 in v1.
- Backlog: [[RecetasDeLaAbuela]] (priority 3, open-download): Spanish-language recipes labelled by Spanish-speaking country; per-country counts not known yet.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table in the vault or `Backlog/`; [[USDA FoodData Central]] is the fallback.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 163 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 1,025 ethnobotany records, 499 taxa. [[KNApSAcK Family]] has a World-map page for it (edible/medicinal species records), not scraped, so no count in the vault.
- Compound → effect chains via the [[Global]] backbones ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No Venezuelan FCT and no recipe set with amounts.
